title: Apple reveals new Mac security controls as AI agents raise privacy risks
slides: Can Apple keep AI agents from leaking your data?
New Mac security controls target AI agent access
But agents can still read files once granted permission
Users must now approve each agent's file access manually
Audit your current agent permissions today
thread_text:
1. Can Apple stop AI leaks?

Apple is adding Mac security controls that force every AI agent to get manual approval before reading any file. The real test: what happens after you click allow?

2. New controls, same blind spot

macOS now prompts you each time an agent requests file access. But once granted, the agent can read anything in that scope—no further checks.

3. Permission is not a leash

After approval, an agent can still read every file it was granted, even ones you forgot about. Apple's controls limit the ask, not the access.

4. The manual approval trap

You'll approve each agent's file access by hand. That's friction, not security—most users will click yes without reading the scope.

5. Audit your agents now

Open your Mac's privacy settings and list every app with file access. Revoke anything you don't recognize. Do it today—before an agent does it for you.

But once you approve, the agent can read everything in scope.
You'll manually approve each agent's file access, every time.
That's friction, not security—most people will just click yes.
Audit your current agent permissions today and revoke what you don't need.

instagram.caption:
Apple's new Mac controls make every AI agent ask permission before reading a file — but once you click allow, it can read everything in that scope, no further checks.

The approval is manual, per agent, per scope. Friction, not a leash: most people will click yes without reading what they just handed over.

Apple limits the ask, not the access.

If you work with client files or drafts on your Mac, an agent you approved months ago may still reach files you forgot existed.

Open your Mac's privacy settings, list every app with file access, and revoke what you don't recognize. 🛡️ Do it before an agent does it for you. 🔍

How many agents have you already said yes to? 👀
